reels.caption:
Islam Makhachev vence por decisão x Ian Gary Machado UFC 330. 

Islam beats Ian Gary in a decision. 

#iangarybrasil #is
good: Strong average watch time (7.0s) — viewers stay engaged through full reel, indicating narrative holds attention
Professional UFC branding and decision graphics build credibility and clarity
Clear story arc from action to victory to celebration provides satisfying payoff
Good reach ratio (80% of views reached organically) shows algorithm likes the content
bad: Hook leads with victory pose, not explosive fighting action — lacks immediate scroll-stopping visual impact
Grappling-heavy content is less visually dynamic than striking — ground fighting doesn't translate as viscerally on short-form video
Extremely low save rate (16 saves = 0.07%) — decision wins lack re-watch value compared to KOs/KTOs
No visible call-to-action — missing engagement driver for comments or follows
reels.top_tip: Lead with the most explosive fight moment (striking exchange or takedown) in frame 1 instead of the victory pose — prioritize visual shock value in the hook to stop the scroll before the decision announcement

reels.caption:
Jack Della Maddalena preve Islam x Gary no UFC 330. 

JDM preview of Islam Makhachev x Ian Gary this weekend at UFC 330.
good: UFC branding and logo consistently visible
Direct-to-camera delivery establishes credibility as a fighter
B-roll weigh-in footage adds visual variety in lower third
Portuguese text targets regional market effectively
bad: Hook is a static talking head with no visual jolt — low scroll-stopping power
Reel leads with previewer instead of fighters; Islam/Gary footage should be hero content, not B-roll
No dramatic reaction, facial expression peak, or emotional spike in first 3 seconds
Text-heavy overlay requires reading; no dynamic on-screen call-to-action ("tap to see predictions" etc.)
reels.top_tip: Restructure: open on the Islam vs Gary weigh-in confrontation or most dramatic fighter moment (0-2s), then cut to JDM's prediction voiceover. Talking-head previews underperform for fight sports — audiences want fighter drama, not commentary.

3 top KO e TKO’s do UFC 330. 
Concorda ou teve melhor? 

Top 3 KO and TKO’s for UFC 330 Islam Makhachev x Ian Machado Ga
good: Strong viewer commitment: 4.6s average watch time shows engaged audience stays once hooked—indicates content and pacing work well
Numbered list format drives completion: Ranking structure creates curiosity to see all 3 KOs
Clear visual hierarchy: Fighter names and bonus amounts ($100K) are readable and guide viewer attention
High-impact action footage: MMA KO moments are visually arresting when not buried under overlays
bad: Text-heavy hook kills scroll-stopping power: Opening frame layers title card ('BEST KO & TKO'S') + logo over action in critical first 0.5s—competes for attention instead of dominating
Zero saves indicates low utility or emotional payoff: Viewers don't find this memorable or worth keeping
Weak call-to-action: 'Concorda ou teve melhor?' (Do you agree?) is passive—doesn't compel shares or comments
Low algorithmic reach (273 from 422 views = 65%): Algorithm isn't distributing because hook isn't stopping enough scrollers
reels.top_tip: Lead first frame with the most brutal KO moment unobstructed (no text, no logo)—let pure shock impact stop scrollers in 0.5s, then cut to ranked format. Your 4.6s watch time proves people stay once engaged; the barrier is the hook itself.

reels.caption:
Jack Della Maddalena preve Mackenzie x Robertson UFC 330.

JDM’s fight preview for the co-main event at UFC 330. 

#mack
good: Strong hook: fighter's face fills frame immediately in extreme closeup — scroll-stopping for MMA audience
Niche clarity: UFC 330 with specific fighter names targets the right audience segment
Average watch time 3.9s shows viewers engage past the initial hook
bad: Minimal on-screen text creates confusion — viewers may not immediately understand this is a fight preview
Static repetitive framing across all clips (same closeup) with no visual progression or fight footage
Very low engagement (2.6%, zero shares, one save) indicates poor shareability despite reasonable views
Neutral/expressionless subject — MMA prediction content needs dramatic reaction or intensity to drive engagement
reels.top_tip: Add dynamic on-screen prediction overlay (e.g., prediction text, pick graphic, or JDM's verbal take) and cut in actual fight highlights to create narrative momentum instead of relying on static face closeup
